about: Cross-key rules the schemas do not encode. when: all, any or a test of one key (set, eq, in, lt, on = a switch counts as set, falsy = value 0, false or empty); layer limits where the key is looked up. A rule without when is a static note on its keys. Each rule cites a source url and a verbatim quote that test/settings.test.mjs finds in the pinned copy of that page (test/fixtures/settings-docs.json).

rules.message: The advisor stays off while a switch that turns feature-flag fetching off is set.
rules.fix: unset the switch, or unset advisorModel
rules.quote: In a session where a variable that turns flag fetching off is set, such as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`, the advisor stays off.

rules.message: The advisor ranks below the main model, so Claude Code does not attach it. Checked only for full model IDs: an alias such as opus resolves to whatever Claude Code's current default is.
rules.fix: pick an advisor that ranks at or above the main model
rules.quote: an advisor must rank at or above your session's main model

rules.message: Remote Control is unavailable while CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC or DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK is set, so it cannot connect at startup.
rules.fix: unset the switch, or set remoteControlAtStartup to false
rules.quote: If you set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` or `DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK`, Remote Control is unavailable.

rules.message: Remote Control stays available with only DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK set, unless your organization requires Trusted Devices; it needs Claude Code v2.1.283 or later.
rules.quote: If you set only `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK`, Remote Control stays available unless your organization requires

rules.message: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC stops auto-updates, so the update channel has no effect.
rules.fix: unset the switch, or unset autoUpdatesChannel
rules.quote: to disable nonessential network traffic: auto-updates, telemetry, error reporting

rules.message: Turns feature-flag fetching off: the advisor stays off, /import, /skill-doctor and idle compaction stop, Remote Control is limited, and the nonessential-traffic switch also stops auto-updates.
quote: [compact a long conversation while your terminal session is idle]

rules.message: The top-level effortLevel in the user file differs from the level saved under modelSettings for a model, and is likely a no-op there: Opus 5.5 and later models ignore it and use the saved level. Setting both to the same level, as BenchKeeper's setup does, is not flagged.
rules.fix: remove effortLevel from the user file, or make it the same as the saved levels
rules.quote: Opus 5.5 and models released after it ignore it and start at their own default until you save a level for them

rules.message: includeCoAuthoredBy is deprecated and is overruled by attribution when that sets commit or pr.
auto and bypassPermissions in a project or local file are silently ignored; only the user file takes them.
rules.fix: remove the key from the project or local file, or set it in the user file
rules.quote: `auto` and `bypassPermissions` don't take effect from project or local settings

rules.message: Transcripts older than this many days are deleted without a message; the Sessions board reads them, so a value below 30 shortens its history.
rules.fix: raise cleanupPeriodDays to 30 or more, or keep it on purpose
rules.quote: The sweep deletes transcripts without showing a message

rules.message: {key} counts as set even with 0 or false.
rules.fix: remove {key}; the editor writes 1 or removes the key
quote: **Setting it to `0` or `false` still opts out**
**Setting it to `0` or `false` still disables this traffic**

rules.message: OpenTelemetry export variables in a project or local env block are ignored; set them in the user settings, the shell or managed settings.
rules.fix: move the variable to the user file

rules.message: The docs say false also disables custom OTLP metrics exporters; the schema at rust-v0.164.0 says they stay enabled and are controlled by otel.metrics_exporter. Set that key to "none" to be sure.
rules.quote: false also disables custom OTLP metrics exporters

rules.message: A project-local .codex/config.toml cannot set notify or otel (they are ignored there), and it loads only for trusted projects.
rules.fix: move the key to the user config
rules.quote: notify , profile , profiles , experimental_realtime_ws_base_url , and otel when they appear in a project-local .codex/config.toml

rules.message: default_permissions is not combined with sandbox_mode.
approval_policy never with sandbox_mode danger-full-access runs every command without a prompt and without a sandbox.
Folders in [projects."<path>"] that no longer exist (worktrees pile up there) are listed with a remove action; nothing is removed on its own.
